book.name: 2 Timoti
book.title: Ɓaria cauterǝa mala Bulǝs aban ká a ban TIMOTI

content: À kwarkir Timoti ɓǝ̀ tamsǝ kusǝìace lidǝmba mala túrómala Ɓakuli
Ən nggǝ nunkiro a ɓadǝm Ɓakuli andǝ Kǝrǝsti Yesu, mǝnana nǝ̀ yia ɓashì aɓwana mǝnana à ndanǝ yilǝmu andǝ amǝnana à wuna ka, a pwari yiu male mǝnana nǝ̀ yiu a dumsǝ domurǝm male ka.
We ka, hamnǝ cau mala Ɓakuli. Do aɓa gilǝrǝu ace mǝnia yì túró ka, ko njar nda kam ko pà kàm ɗàng. Lǝmdǝì aɓwana ɓwarkio malea, nunkiria, sǝ wu ɓak ɓabumia nǝ munyi mǝgule andǝ kwarkiru ɓukɓuk.

Acemǝnana pwari nda kǝ yiu ka, mǝnana ɓwapǝndǝa pa nǝ̀ earnǝ kanigir mǝɓoarne raka. A kun mani ka, à nǝ̀ ramba amǝkànìgìr a rǝia, mǝnana à nǝ̀ pwasǝbumia nǝ nea wia gìr mǝnana kiria kǝ oākia arǝì, sǝ à earkiyi ce oe ka.
À nǝ̀ ɓinǝ mǝsǝcau, à pànǝ earce oe ɗang, à nǝ̀ o atà njarnzǝne.
Sǝ we ka, hami rǝo aɓa koya ulang ɓealu mala do, dumnǝ gandǝrǝu aɓa nutanni, pak túró mala Mǝhama, lùmsǝ túró mǝnana a pakkiyi ace Ɓakuli ka.
Ma mem ngga, pwari kārǝ́na ɓǝ̀ ǝn pa yilǝmem kǝla ɓoro mǝnana a pè Ɓakuli ka. Pwari nying ɓanza mem kārǝ́na.
Ən munǝna munǝo mǝɓoarne, mire mem bwalǝna masǝlǝate, sǝ ǝn camǝna kàngkàng aɓa paɓamuru arǝ Kǝrǝsti māna à pam a buam ngga.

Sǝ ado ka, tangnakusǝam, yì jeko mala túró-cauɓoarna ka, nda rǝ kundǝam, mǝnana Mǝtalabangŋo, Mǝɓashi aɓa mǝsǝcau nǝ̀ pam a Pwari nyare male ka. Sǝ tangnakusǝu man ngga pa acem nǝmurǝam ɗàng, nda gbal acea aɓwana mǝnana kat à kǝ earce yiu male ka.
Masǝlǝata cau mala Bulǝs
Timoti, ɓariki, yiu a banam a kaurǝa.
Acemǝnana Dimas ɗeki nam, ace earce mǝnia yì ɓanza ka, umǝna a Tasalonika. Sǝ Kǝrǝsen ngga, umǝna a Galati, sǝ mala Titus ka, umǝna a Dalmatiya.
Kǝ Luka, nda mǝnana a banam ngga. Ɓǝ̀ a nǝ yiu ka, wu yiu wunǝ Markus, acemǝnana nǝ̀ yia bwalàm nggàm arǝ túró mem.
Tikikus ka, ǝn turni a Afisu.
Ɓǝ̀ a nǝ yiu ka, yinǝàm nǝ nggea-daura mǝnana ǝn nyi a Tǝros, a ɓala mala Karpus ka. Sǝ wu yinǝàm nǝ amalǝmce mem, andǝ anggu mǝnana à nǝ̀ gilǝ gir aɓalǝia ka.
Alizanda mǝ'ntùl, pakkam gìr mǝɓike
kǝ̀rkǝ́r. Ɓakuli nǝ̀ ɓashi wi ace agir mǝnana pàk ka.
We gbal ka, tsǝk kiro arǝì, acemǝnana kǝ munǝ arǝ koya cau sǝm bang ngga.
Tita ká mem a ɓadǝm mǝ'ɓashi ka, kǝɓwa cam a nzǝmam ɗàng. Aɓwana mesǝe, à nyem nǝmurǝam. Ɓakuli ɓǝ̀ twalia wia banì, ɓǝ̀ kǝa ɓashia wia ɗàng.

Sǝama Mǝtalabangŋo nda atàm sǝ pam rǝcandǝa ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ ǝn hamnǝ Cau Amsǝban kat ace aɓwana mana amǝ Yahudi na raka ɓǝà oè. Nyar ɗǝm ngga, amsǝam a bu lú, a kún a'im mǝnana ɓǝ́ à nǝ̀ túrǎm aɓalǝia ka.
Yì, Mǝtalabangŋo ka, nǝ̀ amsǝam aɓalǝ aɓealɓikea kat, sǝ nǝ̀ kánǝ mim jam aɓa domurǝm male mala kùli. Gulo ka, male na kat, masǝlǝate pà kàm ɗàng. Ɓǝ̀ do anggo.
Masǝlǝata makkun mala Bulǝs
Makkia Pǝrisǝla andǝ Akila kûn, andǝ amǝɓala mala Onisǝforǝs.
Arasǝtus ka, nda più a Korinti, sǝ Tǝrofimus ka, ǝn nyi nǝ rǝkwana a Miletus.
Ɓariki, yiu sǝ ɓǝ̀ kunɗwal sulǝo. Yubulǝs kǝ makko kûn, sǝ anggo gbal Pudem, andǝ Linos, andǝ Kǝlaudiya, andǝ acilia amǝ'eamrǝarǝu kat.
Ɓǝ̀ Mǝtalabangŋo do atà bangŋo mò. Ɓǝ̀ ɓwamuru male do atà wun kat.

footnotes.text: Ɓalli gbal aɓa: Atúró 20:4; Afi 6:21,22; Kol 4:7,8.
